result.summary: Found 2 issues: a critical data/display bug showing €NaN for delivery fee, and a minor layout issue with a restaurant name overflowing its card.

issues.description: Smash Bros Burgers shows '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid delivery fee, indicating a failed number format or missing price value.
issues.suggestion: Handle missing or invalid delivery fees with a fallback (e.g. 'Free' or '—') and never render NaN to users.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is cut off at the card edge without ellipsis or wrapping.
issues.suggestion: Truncate overflowing titles with an ellipsis or allow wrapping so the full name remains readable.
